explanation: Merged main (#30-#35) into the bundle-reader branch. From this branch: bundleReader.test.ts pins the writer-to-reader round trip, strict JSONP parsing (including a linear-time refusal of an adversarial unclosed comment header) and registry unit precedence; bundleReaderParity.test.ts pins Node reader labels to loadDatasetMeta for every committed meta.js; agentExport.test.ts reads published bytes through readJsonp and asserts the reviewed GSE174085 label. From main: queryWire.test.ts pins the query-index wire names, row codecs and lowPower rule; csv tests pin the CSV seam; hypomap, expressionSurvey and sourceJson tests cover the co-detection client, survey derivation and expression-source reader.
